description: The `=` itself is required, not merely an initializer somewhere after the name: global-statement ::= "global" name "=" expression (spec/grammar.md:157) has no form in which the two operands sit adjacent. This is the case a reader that dropped the `=` check entirely would still pass without — the other negative fixtures all fail for an earlier reason (a colon-name, an end of line, a stray colon), so each of them survives that defect.
